sourceText: I'm instructing a training on Copilot 365 in Microsoft Word to accountants.  I'd like an example file to help me showcase some of the Copilot features.  Can you provide me with an example document (e.g. an accounting memo) and then some guidelines on how I could utilize that memo to showcase some of the features?  For instance, if I want to showcase the "Auto Rewrite" feature, make sure the document you provide has a paragraph that would need to be rewritten.

Create a fill in the blanks using these vocabulary: eat outside, get lost, go canoeing, go on a roller coaster, have a picnic, make friends, ride on a motorcycle, see a shooting start, sleep in a tent, swim in a lake. Use affirmative, negative and interrogative. include the directions for the activity. Include the other words understandable for children infer where to write the correct word. The activity must be not much complicated for them. Add in the directions that they should use the simple past.

We sent this message to users " According to our records, you are currently running Windows 10.

Windows 10 is reaching end of support soon. This means that the computer may be blocked from the network without notice. We have created this ticket to assess and upgrade the operating system to Windows 11 Pro version." I need to follow up. The user did not respond. I need a follow up message with urgency that prompts them to want to create a time and date to upgrade when they have a few hours open on their calendar.

does this response even make sense:

No, even with a new credit card and a billing address within the restricted zone, a Dodger fan likely will not be able to purchase tickets to a Padres home game if ticket sales are restricted to residents of specific areas. The Padres have been known to restrict ticket sales to specific areas for games against the Dodgers, using credit card billing addresses to determine residency. If a sale is made outside the allowed area, it will be canceled, and a refund issued, according to Yahoo Sports.

Write a cold email to teachers at independent schools in New Zealand introducing me telling them about Oxford Mathematics and Statistics for Aotearoa New Zealand. Take information from this website: https://www.oxforddigital.co.nz/pld.html and list the key benefits of the programme. Provide teachers with links to the website with samples as well as an introductory video. Tell them that we are available to answer any questions, or organise information sessions if they are interested in implementing the refreshed New Zealand Mathematics Curriculum.
